heading: Maggie Bittarelli
whatIsNow: (This is a now page, and if you have your own site, you should make one, too.)
lastUpdated: April 29, 2025, from the Greater Boston Area, MA

updates.heading: Peas are in the ground
paragraphs: Around this time of year, I get antsy to move my seedlings from my grow tent outside into the ground. I direct sowed some peas about a week ago and see little shoots popping up! It'll be very satisfying to get things planted over the next month. I'm really excited for an increased number of flowers to cut, and a more full herb garden.

updates.heading: Rewatching Handmaid's Tale
paragraphs: Er.. maybe not the best time to be doing a complete rewatch of this series. I find myself feeling terrified, sometimes grief-stricken through the day following re-viewings. The uncertainty and change taking place in this country feel similarly bewildering compared to the way that events played out/are depicted in the show, around how the USA suddenly became Gilead, and most people simply complied.

updates.heading: Enjoying work
paragraphs: I joined a new dev team in January, and have been enjoying the newness, the challenges, and my teammates. I work remotely but took a day to visit the office and was so impressed; we have such a nice space, great workstations, amazing snacks and catered lunch... I've never felt so comfortable in an office space.
